idea-plugin.name: WebPane

action.description: Open a WebPane in a ToolWindow

idea-plugin.description:
A lightweight browser plugin for JetBrains IDEs. Adds an integrated browser panel on the right side of the editor, powered by JCEF (Chromium Embedded Framework).

Features:
- Browse the web without leaving your IDE
- Test front-end code (HTML/CSS/JS) in real time
- Built-in DevTools (F12) for debugging
- Zoom, forward/backward navigation, and memory usage monitoring
- Quick-open HTML files via gutter icon

为JetBrains IDE提供轻量级内置浏览器面板，基于JCEF (Chromium Embedded Framework)，支持网页浏览、前端代码实时预览、F12开发者工具、缩放导航及内存监控等功能。
